body.name: Exact lock compiler
body.construction: Apply rational row reduction to \(E_T\) and \(b_T\); when the augmented-rank test passes, select a rational \(q\in\ker(E_T)\) with \(b_Tq\neq0\), set \(v=R_Tq\), choose a nonzero rational \(t\) inside the exact positivity radius, and expand the supplied represented graph and forest data together with \(\mathbf M(0),\mathbf M(t)\) into \(\Gamma\).
